description:
List brands

Lists the selected organization's 10DLC brands as a cursor-paginated page. Use status to filter the result and pageSize and pageToken to navigate it. Entries use a brand summary representation (identifier, display name, profile type, entity type when present, status and timestamps) rather than the full redacted brand; use getTenDlcBrand to read a brand's redacted registration details. Supply organization_id for the organization that owns the registration.

API reference: https://photon.codes/docs/beta/api-reference/10dlc-brands/list-brands
name: listTenDlcBrands

entityType.description: Known values: ["private_profit","non_profit"]. Others may be added.

status.description: Known values: ["submitting","submitted","action_required","otp_required","verified","vetted_verified","manual_review"]. Others may be added.

type.description: Known values: ["organization","sole_proprietor"]. Others may be added.

title: List brands
